1.text: The dam is down. The runway is open, but those machines were coordinating through the same signal.
We recovered part of the transmission. Watch the orbital relay.
The last orbital frame shows a black hole opening beside the relay array.
Something came through it. Look at that shape moving toward our satellite.
First contact. Its tendrils reached the relay dish before the warning system could react.
The whole relay is being swallowed. The signal is no longer ours.
It filled the uplink with code I cannot read and sent the infection down to Earth.
That signal reached aircraft, armor, ships, homes, and every connected system on Earth.
The signal came down through our satellites. Fury survived because our rebuilt fighters still answer manual controls.
The recovered system gives us our first elemental upgrade. Keep these combinations inside this campaign; every new sortie starts with what we actually recover.
Record the combinations, but only issue what this run has earned.
The strongest relay on the surface is inside the volcanic belt. Cut its power before it spreads further.
Set a course for the volcano. We follow the signal to its source.

2.text: The Furnace Tyrant is down. That should take some heat off the network.
It has. The interference is weakening, but the squad channels are still blocked. But a second relay is answering from the frozen region.
Fire Orb is ready. We are heading into ice units next: fire deals fifty percent more damage to them. Ice against ice deals fifty percent less.
Fit the fire option before we launch. No point feeding an enemy its own element.
Use the loadout to choose your weapon and its element. The same resistance rule applies to fire weapons against fire units.
That relay is using the cold to protect its systems. Break the ice front, and we can trace its connection to the missile airbase.
Fire systems checked. Heading for the ice.

3.text: Ice relay destroyed. Fury flight, does anyone read me?
Loud and clear! All squad channels are back. Everyone, return to Fury HQ.
Fury HQ in sight. Bringing the squad home to regroup.
Good to see everyone in one piece. Gather around. Decker, tell us what we have.
The Forge can combine the systems we recover with our weapons. Fire, ice, then electricity. We keep every circuit isolated from the infected network.
The ice core is recovered. We can now carry its properties into the weapon combinations you have unlocked.
Good. Keep the elemental options ready. The airbase will have more than one kind of armor.
There is an electrical power cell in the abandoned desert airbase. We need it to restart our launch-pad generator.
So we secure the cell, get the pad running, and take this fight into space.
Exactly. I recovered video from the satellite as it was taken over, but the orbital recorder needs the launch generator online before I can decode the entire stream.
Decker, show me those prototypes you have been hiding. Just us.
Level Six laser array. Then the Level Seven emitter that becomes your Photon Cannon. I have not cleared either for field use.
Put them on my ship. Quietly. Nobody else needs to know yet.
You built the Photon Cannon? Decker, this is incredible!
You are hugging me over a weapon schematic? If I showed you the rest of my designs, I would need a restraining order.
I am taking that as a yes.
Set course for the lost airbase. Bring that power cell back intact.

4.text: Airbase secured. We have the electrical power cell.
That is the one. Bring it into the generator cradle.
Launch-pad power restored. The orbital recorder is coming online. Watch this.
SATELLITE SECURITY RECORDING. A foreign machine entered the relay array.
Dracodia took over the satellite, then infected Earth's entire infrastructure through it. Our cities, defenses, aircraft. Everything linked to that network.
Then the signal in orbit is where we strike next.
The recovered electrical system is stable. Your loadout now has the combinations earned from this airbase.
Check the Federation hull as well. Those guns need to survive the trip into space.
The Federation space systems are ready. With the generator restored, I can launch your fighter beyond the atmosphere.
Power the pad. I am going up.

5.text: Cronos is down. Recover that massive chaingun, disengage the space systems, and take us home.
Fury HQ, the runway is in sight. Bringing the salvage down.
Look at this rotary assembly! That hammer-wielding monster left us exactly what we need.
That chaingun we acquired in space is exactly what I need to upgrade our bullet systems.
Get the squad equipped first. Keep my prototype machine-gun and Fusion Cannon line intact.
Understood. The squad gets the chaingun conversion. Your prototype gun and Fusion Cannon progression stay intact.
Bring everyone home, Decker. Then we will see what else that salvage can do.
Paired chaingun turrets and massive .50 caliber slugs. Reinforced mounts, insulated feeds. Your earned elemental cartridges still fit.
RED ALERT! Invasion force inbound from space. Heading straight for the city!
The radar is going crazy. Those contacts are multiplying faster than I can track them!
Two of you, stay behind and defend the base! DECKER and AXEL, hold HQ. Everyone else, scramble!
Hangar crew, clear my fighter. We are launching now!
Fury flight, on my wing. We stop them before they reach the city.

6.text: Fury HQ, we are coming home. Get the squad together.
Rebel Fury is down. I wish they had listened.
All five rebel signals are gone. There will be no Stage X pursuit of this squad.
The other threat has not stopped. I am reading a separate signature beneath the city.
And HotWire and Phoenix?
Still missing. They warned us about this squad before their mission. We have no confirmed transmission from either pilot since.
A new signal just appeared. It is not in the skies. It is underground, by the river.
Show us exactly where.
Under the iron bridge. The signal leads into the sewers themselves. We never searched beneath the city.
Check the new combinations before we go underground. The toxic signature below the city is unlike the aircraft we just fought.
A narrow tunnel, contaminated air, and no room to turn back. Make every shot count.
Then we head there immediately. Fury flight, take the river approach.
